item.text:
**Verdict:** **Yes, substantially.** In 2024 AMLO turned the 4T program into concrete budget priorities, institutions, staffing rules, delivery channels, and some enforcement. The main caveat is that some implementation also served power-consolidation and patronage-sensitive goals.

## Accepted Claims

- [Presidente anuncia aumentos en Programas para el Bienestar en presupuesto de 2024; todas las obras públicas se terminarán, afirma](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-anuncia-aumentos-en-programas-para-el-bienestar-en-presupuesto-de-2024-todas-las-obras-publicas-se-terminaran-afirma/) | Presidencia de México | 2023-09-07 | Claim: AMLO said the 2024 budget would raise all welfare programs, fully fund major public works, and increase pay for health and education personnel, which is direct budget translation of the program. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [02.01.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador, desde Tabasco](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/02-01-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador-desde-tabasco/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-02 | Claim: He set explicit final-term priorities: universal health care, finished public works, and basification / wage improvement for teachers and health workers. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [IMSS-Bienestar opera en 23 entidades para atender a 53.2 millones de mexicanos que no tienen seguridad social](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170) | IMSS | 2024-04-17 | Claim: The government described IMSS-Bienestar as a nationwide system with defined coverage, facilities, workers, and a formal plan to basify staff and finish hospitals, showing program-to-institution translation. | QIDs: 8B.2

- [IMSS-Bienestar, legado del presidente al pueblo de México, se va a consolidar en el próximo sexenio: Zoé Robledo](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202409/490) | IMSS | 2024-09-24 | Claim: The administration reported a large expansion of IMSS-Bienestar staffing and facilities, with metrics for hospitals, clinics, and workforce, indicating an institutionalized implementation mechanism rather than just rhetoric. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Banco del Bienestar suma 26.5 millones de cuentas por Programas para el Bienestar](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/banco-del-bienestar-suma-26-5-millones-de-cuentas-por-programas-para-el-bienestar/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-07-05 | Claim: Benefits were being paid through 26.5 million direct accounts with no intermediaries, which is a concrete delivery mechanism designed into the program. | QIDs: 8B.2, 7B.9

- [Tarjetas del Banco del Bienestar no se renovarán con cambio de administración](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/tarjetas-del-banco-del-bienestar-no-se-renovaran-con-cambio-de-administracion/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-09-10 | Claim: The outgoing government said benefit cards would not be replaced after the transition and payments would continue normally, showing continuity planning and administrative handoff. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay; debe más de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15 | Claim: The administration publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected firm, showing concrete enforcement against a powerful business actor. | QIDs: 8B.2, 7B.9

- [Presidente López Obrador y virtual presidenta electa Sheinbaum alistan transición y reformas para continuar la 4T](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-lopez-obrador-y-virtual-presidenta-electa-sheinbaum-alistan-transicion-y-reformas-para-continuar-la-4t/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-10 | Claim: AMLO and Sheinbaum explicitly coordinated transition and continuity of the 4T, so the program was not just conceptual but handed off through a formal succession plan. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

### Counterevidence

- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with super-majority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters | 2024-06-04 | Claim: Reuters reported the INE overhaul and related reforms were seen by critics as a way to cement Morena hegemony, so some “implementation” was really regime entrenchment. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | Reuters | 2024-09-15 | Claim: The judicial overhaul was sold as citizen-serving but criticized as weakening judicial independence, meaning the institutional program reduced neutral constraints as it translated into law. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Programas para el Bienestar: evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | Claim: The government said Jan-Feb payments were advanced before the electoral blackout, which shows election-sensitive timing and patronage risk inside the implementation model. | QIDs: 8B.2, 7B.9

- [Informe Mundial 2024: México](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | Claim: HRW said AMLO blocked INAI appointments and transferred many state functions to the military, which weakens institutional capacity and independence even when a plan exists on paper. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Mexico: Proposed Constitutional Changes Threaten Rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | Claim: HRW said proposed reforms would expand military power, weaken judicial independence, and abolish transparency/privacy safeguards, so the implementation machinery also served power concentration. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Mexico - Digital News Report 2024](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | Claim: The overview links AMLO’s final-year rhetoric, attacks on journalists, and the NYT phone-number episode to a hostile climate for scrutiny, which cut against genuinely open, corrective implementation. | QIDs: 8B.2, 8B.1

## Synthesis

AMLO did translate his 2024 program into concrete action. The clearest examples are the 2024 budget for welfare/public works, IMSS-Bienestar’s staffing and facility rollout, direct-deposit welfare administration, formal transition planning, and tax-enforcement actions against politically connected firms.

The negative side is that some of the same implementation capacity was used to weaken checks, especially INAI, the judiciary, and the National Guard/civilian-security boundary. So the answer to 8B.2 is **yes**, but with a major warning that implementation often blended policy delivery with institutional capture and patronage-sensitive timing.

## Search Gap

I found strong evidence on budgets, institutions, staffing, and enforcement, but not a single independent 2024 source that ties all of AMLO’s stated goals into one verified implementation scorecard. The evidence is therefore assembled from official program documents plus independent reporting on the main countervailing institutions.
